description: Fetch one bundled catalog part. Prefer `await lib.standard.nema17()` and `await lib.standard.bearing608()` — they are offline and do not download remote STEP. A lookup that cannot finish fails within 45s with errorCode parts.lookup.timeout. Do not retry in parallel.

includeModel.description: Resolve a hash-verified STEP/GLB model file instead of the plain catalog STEP record.

model.description: Verified model options; supplying model implies includeModel.

expectedBboxMm.description: Expected [x,y,z] dimensions to compare with the measured model.

license.description: License string supplied by the source.

sha256.description: Required SHA-256 digest for an explicit URL; for catalog parts it overrides the catalog GLB digest.

source.description: Catalog or manufacturer name, such as KiCad Packages3D.

url.description: Direct public HTTPS .step/.stp/.glb download URL. Requires sha256, source and license.

partsBaseUrl.description: Opt-in remote endpoint; no default value ships with kernelCAD.

name: fetch_part
title: Fetch Part
